verdicts_or_reports.element: Bestiary sorting controls and enemy list
verdicts_or_reports.expected: In landscape, the bestiary sort controls (A–Z / By Location) and enemy list remain accessible by scrolling or fit within the screen.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After rotating to landscape, only All and Missing filters are present in the visible bestiary content; A–Z / By Location controls and the enemy rows shown in portrait disappear. Swiping up does not reveal them.
steps: Open Profile > Bestiary in portrait and note A–Z / By Location and the enemy list are visible.
Observe that sort controls and enemy rows are absent.
Swipe up in the bestiary content; the absent controls and rows remain unavailable.
Rotate portrait, then landscape again; same result.

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes: Completed shop, gear/equipment, and bestiary sweep. One confirmed landscape bestiary clipping/accessibility issue filed and logged; shop preview/cancel and item quantity bounds behaved as expected, and temporary body equipment change was reversed.
